## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-4-5f46d44d`

PlantPreset and SubstratePreset do not implement param_meta support. The acceptance criteria states the schema should be 'flexible enough for both chemistry and biology parameters.' The ParamMeta schema itself is flexible, but plant parameters like growth_rate_index and water_column_uptake_bias — which are biology-relevant scientific parameters — cannot carry provenance at the preset level. Consider adding param_meta to PlantPreset (at minimum) for consistency, since the next bead (tanksim-6e5.7.2: 'Attach provenance to high-value chemistry and ecology parameters') will need to annotate plant params.

### `fr-4-6586f129`

The acceptance criteria requires 'Decide how provenance is stored for code-defined defaults versus data-file parameters.' The implementation correctly uses TOML-level provenance for data-file params, and ProcessParams::Default has no inline provenance. However, this design decision is not documented anywhere — there is no comment in provenance.rs, process.rs, or the TOML files explicitly stating that code-defined defaults inherit provenance only when loaded through a TOML preset file, and that ProcessParams::Default values constructed without TOML have no provenance path. Add a brief design note (e.g., in provenance.rs or ROUTING.md) so downstream contributors understand the provenance boundary.

### `fr-4-fae98202`

Update the shrimp provenance path so omitted optional fields fall back to the runtime defaults before formatting and range checks. Today `ShrimpPreset::lookup_param_value` returns `None` for optional fields such as `body_*`, `juvenile_to_subadult_days`, `base_clutch_size`, and `min_clutch_condition` when the TOML omits them (`crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:304-317`, `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:476-502`), but `shrimp_preset_to_params` later injects real defaults from `ShrimpRuntimeParams::default()` (`crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:550-597`). That makes provenance on code-defined shrimp defaults effectively write-only: `format_param()` and `check_ranges()` never surface it even though the runtime uses a concrete value.

### `fr-4-66f7e16d`

Make the new process-parameter formatter stop renormalizing legacy `_mg` / `_mg_total` values unless it can also show the corresponding metadata/unit, or automatically attach that derived unit. `ParamMetaPreset::format_param` currently calls `provenance_param_value()` before it checks whether any `param_meta` exists (`crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:59-64`), and `ProcessParamsPreset::provenance_param_value` always rewrites legacy compatibility fields into reference-tank concentrations (`crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1144-1150`). Because the shipped default process preset intentionally has no `param_meta` (`crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1857-1864`) but still stores `aob_k_tan_mg = 0.5` (`crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml:31`), the debug helper can print a transformed value like `0.025` with no unit/source context, which is misleading.

### `fr-4-c056464d`

Tighten `ProcessParamsPreset::validate` to reject `shrimp_juvenile_maturation_days <= 0`. The validator only rejects negative values today (`crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1334-1387`), but scenario materialization immediately splits that legacy total into stage durations (`crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:546-564`; `crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs:342-354`) and runtime invariants require both resulting fields to be strictly positive (`crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs:316-323`). A custom process preset with `shrimp_juvenile_maturation_days = 0.0` will therefore load successfully and only fail later when the engine is stepped.
